 Summary Statement
 Obligation to provide a confidential report has been met and all initial reporting and compliance measures have been taken to comply with the Conflict of Interest Act .
 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Full-time Member of the Parole Board of Canada, I recused myself on December 11, 2024, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding the revision of a case in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to improperly further the private interests of another person.
The name of the person should not be disclosed pursuant to sec. 51 (2) (b) (vi) of the Conflict of Interest which reads as follows:
51 (2) If a public office holder has recused himself or herself in respect of a matter and a public declaration is made in respect of that recusal under subsection 25 (1) or section 30
(b) no publication of the declaration shall include any detail that could reveal, directly or indirectly, any of the following:
(vi) information that could reasonably be expected to cause injury to the privacy interests of an individual.
